scientific_integrity: Theorem and reproducible standard-library checks provided; proof uses renewal/Bellman contraction, strict transform monotonicity, Jensen convex order and an implicit asymptotic expansion; no external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Identical patches, deterministic continuously declining gain rates, independent nonnegative transits, constant mortality hazard, earned rewards retained at death, and exact model parameters. The small-hazard variance coefficient additionally requires finite third moments and local C2 gain regularity. No claim of empirical calibration or independent historical-priority certification.
title: Travel-time variability shortens optimal residence under background mortality
